T.description: Local prefill chunk tokens; divisible by batch.

batch.description: Equal-length prefill sequences, distinct from S.

block_size.description: Cache capacity rounds down to whole blocks.

context.description: Existing cached tokens per decode sequence.

dp.description: Attention data replicas; expert TP flattens tp*dp.

dtype_a.description: Unquantized scalar dtype; scale/packing overhead excluded.

ep.description: Dense model has no expert parallelism.

gpu_memory_utilization.description: Fraction of device memory budgeted to vLLM.

hbm_bytes.description: Per-device memory bytes; override with catalog hardware preset.

max_num_batched_tokens.description: Profiling prefill token count, independent of context.

pp.description: Equal layer partitions; heaviest stage ledger.

reserved_bytes.description: Catalog estimate for graph capture/allocator reserve.

tp.description: Attention tensor parallel degree. Build default: smallest valid TP choice with memory.kv_tokens > 0 on the snapshot device, keeping all other defaults; if none fits, use the smallest valid TP and retain the zero-capacity warning.
